newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian PM condemns Tel Aviv bombing.
newsitem.headline: Italian PM condemns Tel Aviv bombing.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi condemned Friday's suicide bombing at a Tel Aviv sidewalk cafe as an attempt to derail Middle East peace.
"As in the past terrorism has struck at innocent people in an attempt to hijack the peace process," Prodi said in a message of condolence to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
"It is a flawed strategy which has to be answered by giving a substantial boost to the negotiations," he said.
The attack by a suspected Moslem suicide bomber killed three people, including the attacker. Police said 30 to 40 people were injured.
